items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: any of these people that you name, I've met.

ctx.x: of the songs played on the record, and I didn't get any royalties. And it's just hard to get them. You just don't know how to find a............ I asked a man last year...I asked Keith Smith. "Hey Keith, what about the royalties on the record I made?" He says, "Forget about it." I don't know what he meant by that, you see. But rather than have, you know, a slaughter on Tenth Avenue, you know, you just let it go. You figure if a guy got nerve enough to just take your material and you looking right at him, then…

So, as we begin to look at the overall picture and look back on my life, I feel like that...that I've had a very, very interesting life...I met a lot of people...cross sections. From the Vice President of the United States, Hubert Humphrey, to Jimmy Carter, to Chip Carter, to any outstanding person you name...Hazel Scott, Mrs. Roosevelt, Jackie Onassis, Bobby Kennedy...you know, any of these people that you name, I've met. You know, going from that Travis Tucker's "Let's Go" Company to many of the other things in…
